verdict.rationale: Synctera documents an API that creates and manages customer accounts, supporting multiple account types including SAVING and CHECKING demand deposit accounts. That provides per-customer deposit accounts provisioned programmatically. However, no evidence shows that it issues unique account and routing numbers, offers virtual accounts for reconciliation, or supports sub-accounts under a master structure. Missing for 10: explicit account/routing number issuance, virtual accounts for reconciliation, master/sub-account hierarchy, evidence of scale, independent corroboration.
